function sum(...args: [number, number]): number {
  return args[0] + args[1];
}
function describe(prefix: string, ...args: [number, string]): string {
  return prefix + args[0] + args[1].toUpperCase();
}
function empty(...args: []) { return args.length; }
console.log(sum(2, 3), describe("a", 2, "b"), empty());
const contextual: (...args: [number, string]) => string = (...args) => args[0] + args[1].toUpperCase();
console.log(contextual(4, "c"));
type Concat<T extends unknown[], U extends unknown[]> = [...T, ...U];
type AfterConcrete<T extends unknown[]> = [...number[], ...T];
type BeforeConcrete<T extends unknown[]> = [...T, ...number[]];
type FixedSpreads = [...[number], ...[string]];
type OptionalAfterGeneric<T extends unknown[]> = [...T, string?];
const concatenated: Concat<[number], [string, boolean]> = [1, "two", true];
const afterConcrete: AfterConcrete<[string]> = [1, 2, "three"];
const beforeConcrete: BeforeConcrete<[string]> = ["one", 2, 3];
const fixedSpreads: FixedSpreads = [4, "five"];
const optionalAfterGeneric: OptionalAfterGeneric<[number]> = [6, "seven"];
console.log(concatenated, afterConcrete, beforeConcrete, fixedSpreads, optionalAfterGeneric);
